data.one_liner: A simple Flutter widget to access and take photos using the browser's camera.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget designed for web applications that accesses the browser's camera to capture photos. It returns the captured photo as a base64 encoded string. It also includes an AppBar and camera switching capabilities.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application that needs to capture photos from the browser camera.
You need the captured image returned easily as a base64 encoded string.
avoid_when: You need complex native camera features on mobile platforms like Android and iOS.
You require QR or barcode scanning functionalities.
strengths: Easy to integrate camera access specifically for Flutter web apps.
Returns captured images directly as base64 encoded strings ready for use.
Supports customizable AppBar titles and camera switching when multiple cameras are available.
weaknesses: Camera switching stability can vary across different browsers.
Limited feature set focused primarily on basic photo capture on web.
data.setup_notes: Add simple_web_camera as a dependency in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick the official camera package if you need robust native platform support alongside web.

alternatives.name: camera_web
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use camera_web as the underlying implementation when working with the official camera package ecosystem.
